lines.en: label mikuspringnightgen:
scene mikuspringnightgen

I call Miku and the two of us wind up making a trip to a nearby fast food restaurant so she can replenish her energy stores with what is potentially the least healthy thing you can put inside of your body.
lines.zh: 我给 Miku 打了电话，最后我俩跑了一趟附近的快餐店，好让她用大概是能塞进人身体里最不健康的东西，把自己的能量储备补回来。

lines.en: But hey, if she wants to jeopardize her future self now while she is still young and able-bodied, she’s allowed to do so.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，要是她想趁现在还年轻力壮就先坑一把未来的自己，那也是她的自由。

lines.en: It's not like she's going anywhere. In fact, it's not like she {i}can{/i} go anywhere when we're all perpetually trapped in this world where good things can't exist.
lines.zh: 反正她又跑不掉。事实上，既然我们所有人都永远困在这个容不下好事的世界里，她{i}也{/i}哪儿都去不了。

lines.en: A year ago, it would have been easy to cherish a moment like this. It would have been easy to look at this girl, only half my age, and breathe a sigh of relief as I dig into the flesh of a slaughtered animal.
lines.zh: 一年前，要珍惜这样的时刻很容易。看着这个年纪只有我一半的女孩，一边大口嚼着被宰杀动物的肉，一边松一口气，也很容易。

lines.en: Perhaps when we're done here, she'll take me back to her room where I can slaughter one myself.
lines.zh: 也许等我们吃完，她会带我回她房间，让我也亲手宰一个。

lines.en: scene black
We get our food and settle down at a table near the window and wind up talking about how life has changed lately.
lines.zh: 我们拿了吃的，在靠窗的桌子旁坐下，聊起了最近生活有什么变化。

lines.en: For her, it’s mostly about being able to regularly cum now.
lines.zh: 对她来说，最大的变化大概就是现在能定期高潮了。

lines.en: For me, it’s about regularly struggling to.
lines.zh: 对我来说，是定期地很难做到。

lines.en: Is that the most substantial change my life has made as of late?
lines.zh: 这算是我的生活最近最实质的变化吗？

lines.en: Absolutely fucking not.
But it’s easier to admit that than to admit what the real one is.
lines.zh: 但承认这个，比承认真正的那个要容易。
